Compact-height scrolling remains cumbersome. Full Tab traversal, email-change recovery and every field/toggle combination remain unverified.

Later attachments require lateral discovery. Comprehensive editing/branch navigation, touch and software-keyboard behavior remain unverified.
- **T3-G-final-runtime-r1 / P02:** Accept editorial reading/editing, actual file persistence/reload, confirmed discard, ledger/search navigation and contained table access by wheel. Initial table clipping and sticky-title overlap remain. Horizontal keyboard table access is unresolved and excluded from acceptance.
- **T4-G-final-runtime-r1 / P18:** Accept the bounded Tabler toast increment, failed-snapshot retry preserving later edits, storage distinction and close/focus continuity. Header occlusion and inherited cropped single-line fields remain visible. Broader settings redesign is outside this acceptance.

No additional repair is required for these accepted subsets. Broader untested scope is not accepted by implication. No product was repaired.

This final continuation was condition-disclosed: `condition_blind=false`. Both blind cohorts were frozen before the limited mapping and verified unchanged. The main record retains sixteen original rows and two declared omissions; the prompt-different supplementary replacement attempts remain separate. This is an independent agent product judgment, without human, native-role/model, cost or generalized-superiority claims.
